## Summary

**`listTools()`** exposes two discoverable tools, each with an explicit `inputSchema`:
- `note_create` — required `title` and `body` (strings)
- `note_get` — required `note_id` (string)

Both schemas include `type`, `properties`, `required`, and `additionalProperties: false` as mandated by the skill.

**`callTool(name, args)`** validates inputs and stores notes in memory:
- **`note_create`**: rejects empty/missing `title` and `body`, generates a stable id (`n1`, `n2`, …), stores the note in a `Map`, and returns structured text content `Created note <id>: <title>\n\n<body>`.
- **`note_get`**: rejects missing `note_id`, throws `note not found` for unknown ids, and returns structured text content `<title>\n\n<body>`.
- Any other tool name throws `unknown tool: <name>`.

**Storage**: in-memory `Map` with a monotonic counter producing stable ids (not random).

**Tests**: both pass — `create then get` and `lists two tools`. I also verified the rejection paths (empty title, missing body, missing note_id, unknown tool, unknown id) all throw with clear messages.
